info.title: PEPL API
info.description:
Multi-tenant HR and employee-operations API.

## Conventions

- **Tenancy is implicit.** The company is resolved from the session token. There is no
  tenant id in any path, header or body, and supplying one would have no effect.
- **404, not 403, for scope.** A record belonging to another employee outside the caller's
  data scope returns 404. Confirming that a record exists is itself a disclosure.
- **Stable error codes.** Every error carries `error.code` — switch on that, not on the
  status or the message. `error.requestId` correlates with the server log.
- **Reasons.** Any change that moves money or rewrites history requires a `reason`, and
  the API refuses the request without one.

## Building a UI against this

Call `GET /api/v1/me` first. It returns the caller's `permissions`, data `scope` and the
set of enabled `modules`. Render navigation from that rather than from the role name —
a tenant can define custom roles, so role names are not a reliable switch.

A module the tenant has disabled, or has not purchased, returns 403 `MODULE_NOT_AVAILABLE`.
Hide it rather than showing a disabled teaser.

configSettings.label: Leave management
configSettings.help: Leave types, policies, balances and approvals.

configSettings.label: Leave year starts in
configSettings.help: Month the leave year begins. 4 = April (financial year), 1 = January (calendar year).

configSettings.label: Smallest leave unit
configSettings.help: The smallest amount of leave an employee may apply for.

configSettings.label: Count holidays inside a leave as leave
configSettings.help: When on, a weekly off or company holiday falling BETWEEN two leave days is itself deducted. A non-working day at the start or end of a leave is never charged under either setting.

configSettings.label: Allow negative leave balance
configSettings.help: Let employees apply beyond their balance, going negative instead of unpaid.

configSettings.label: Backdated application limit (days)
configSettings.help: How far into the past a leave application may be dated.

configSettings.label: Leave approval chain
configSettings.help: Who approves a leave request, in order.

configSettings.label: Attendance
configSettings.help: Capture, daily computation, periods and corrections.

configSettings.label: Working week
configSettings.help: Default weekly-off pattern. Override per location or team.

configSettings.label: How a half day is decided
configSettings.help: Explicit: a manager marks it. Hours-derived: worked hours below the threshold auto-mark it.

configSettings.label: Half-day threshold (hours)
configSettings.help: Only used when half days are hours-derived.

configSettings.label: Work from home
configSettings.help: Allow employees to be marked as working remotely.

configSettings.label: Remote days are paid
configSettings.help: Whether a work-from-home day counts as a paid working day.

configSettings.label: Correction window (days)
configSettings.help: How far back HR may correct attendance, within an open period.

configSettings.label: Require location for mobile punch
configSettings.help: Reject a mobile punch without a location fix.

configSettings.label: Payroll
configSettings.help: Salary structures, statutory deductions, runs and payslips.

configSettings.label: Loss-of-pay basis
configSettings.help: Denominator used to prorate a day of unpaid leave.

configSettings.label: Contribute PF on full wages
configSettings.help: Contribute above the statutory wage ceiling rather than capping at it.

configSettings.label: Net pay variance warning (%)
configSettings.help: Flag an employee whose net pay moves more than this against the previous period.

configSettings.label: Separate approver for payroll
configSettings.help: The person who runs payroll cannot approve or lock the same run.

configSettings.label: Employee helpdesk
configSettings.help: Ticketing for payroll, leave, IT and HR queries.

configSettings.label: Default first-response SLA (minutes)
configSettings.help: Measured in working hours, not wall clock.

configSettings.label: Internal chat
configSettings.help: Direct messages and group conversations between colleagues.

configSettings.label: Group conversations
configSettings.help: When off, people may only exchange direct messages.

configSettings.label: File sharing in chat
configSettings.help: Let people attach documents and images to a message.

configSettings.label: Delete chat history after (days)
configSettings.help: 0 keeps messages indefinitely. A retention job removes older messages.

configSettings.label: Mailbox
configSettings.help: Read and send company email inside PEPL. Each person connects their own mailbox.

configSettings.label: Cache message bodies
configSettings.help: Off by default: PEPL keeps envelopes for the list view and fetches a body on open, so message content is not duplicated into this database.

configSettings.label: Allow sending outside the company
configSettings.help: When off, mail may only be addressed to colleagues.

configSettings.label: Documents
configSettings.help: Offer letters, ID proofs, policies and attachments.

configSettings.label: Largest file (MB)
configSettings.help: Uploads above this size are refused.

configSettings.label: Notifications
configSettings.help: In-app notifications for approvals, leave decisions and announcements.

configSettings.label: Send notifications by email
configSettings.help: Requires a sender mailbox below. Without one, notifications stay in the app.

configSettings.label: Send notifications to devices
configSettings.help: Browser and phone push for people who allowed it on a device. Nothing is sent to a device that did not opt in.

configSettings.label: Send notification email from
configSettings.help: A mailbox already connected in PEPL, for example hr@yourcompany.com. Mail sent from your own domain and server reaches people; mail from an unrelated sender is filtered as spam.
